you were on last, and since then you’ve really   reoriented your work a whole lot. You’re now

will get once we have AI that can   perform as well as a human at some crucial 
tasks, what are all the changes you would   expect over the decade following that, 
and then seeing what arises from that.

Then there’s this alternative perspective,

the higher-level trends are very different. So we saw this in early COVID, where a good
